data.one_liner: Type-safe localization package with code generation for YAML and JSON files.
data.what_it_does: Generates 100% type-safe Dart classes from YAML or JSON translation files. Supports pluralization, gender-specific strings, nesting, and runtime locale changes.
use_when: You want compile-time safety and autocompletion for translation keys.
You use YAML or JSON files for managing application translations.
You need advanced localization features like pluralization and gender support.
avoid_when: You prefer runtime-only translation lookup without code generation steps.
You do not want to run a CLI tool during your development workflow.
strengths: Full type-safe code generation prevents missing key compilation errors.
Flexible configuration with support for nested strings, arguments, pluralization, and genders.
Live watch mode for real-time code generation during development.
weaknesses: Requires running a CLI command or build step to generate localizations.
Generates a separate local package inside your workspace.
data.setup_notes: Add dependencies, configure `pubspec.yaml` with localization settings, and run `dart run easiest_localization` to generate code.

alternatives.name: easy_localization
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer runtime loading without compile-time code generation.

alternatives.name: slang
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want another robust type-safe localization generator with different syntax options.
